about: Rules of the player projection model's weekly review. Same process as the game models, scored player-week by player-week on expected PPR points. The simulator spread (vol, yshape) and injury absorption are in the registry but not yet re-tested by the loop.

categories.name: Last season's games
categories.what: how much a player's previous season counts next to this season's games

categories.name: Volume trust
categories.what: how many team plays before a player's own target and carry share outweighs his position's average

categories.name: Efficiency trust
categories.what: how many targets and carries before a player's own catch rate, yards and touchdown rates are trusted

categories.name: Passing trust
categories.what: how many attempts before a quarterback's own completion, yardage, touchdown and interception rates are trusted

categories.name: Opponent pass defence
categories.what: how strongly the opposing pass defence moves a receiver's yards per target

categories.name: Game script
categories.what: how strongly the point spread shifts a team between passing and running
